question: How much AI debt supply do US credit spreads price?
view: Top-rated bond spreads price about two thirds of next year's AI debt supply, while bank loans, private credit and off-balance-sheet vehicles stay unpriced.
lede: Every credit spread widened with the {print_date} prints, and the axis rose to {axis}. No falsifier triggered and no probability moved. Two X accounts describe an equity rebound on 23 Nov, so these spreads may now be too wide.

chain.caption: Top-rated bond spreads carry the priced part, and bonds do not price the debt in loans, private credit and vehicles.
chain.note: Part of the supply effect lands in Treasury yields, in a size the memo cannot state. The IG index spread, at {IG}, shows little of it. A second bank met weak demand for a data-centre loan sale. Wider spreads also slow projects, and slower projects need less debt.

axis.caption: The ratio rose in a flight from risk, and it sits above the 0.52 falsifier line.
axis.note: The grid puts the ratio near {ratio_S2} if 2027 supply arrives in full.

scenarios.note: No probability changed in this update. The moves are changes from today's wider spreads.

items.question: Is a capex cut good for credit?
items.a: Yes for the bonds of the largest spenders, if all cut together. Slower building cuts issuance.
items.b: Signed leases keep fixed claims rising.
